name: volume_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when price breaks above the 1-minute range high with concurrent volume spiking more than 2x the 5-minute baseline, it signals that directional institutional program order flow is actively driving the move rather than passive market-maker adjustment. NIFTY's deep, continuous order book means that random noise rarely produces both range expansion AND volume elevation simultaneously — the confluence indicates genuine buying programs (FIIs, algos executing TWAP/VWAP orders) have overwhelmed the resting sell side. This institutional order flow typically sustains directional pressure for 30-60 seconds as the program continues filling, creating a predictable continuation window for ATM call/put entries.
core_signal_oneliner: Price breaks 1-minute range high/low with concurrent volume spike above 2x the 5-minute rolling average
